name: Wispae War Saga
description: Graphia Academy is engulfed in chaos, with danger lurking at every turn. Rally your wispae army, challenge the heroes of this turbulent era, and reclaim the peace of old!
introduction:
◆ Summary ◆
● Graphia Academy is engulfed in chaos, with danger lurking at every turn. Rally your wispae army, challenge the heroes of this turbulent era, and reclaim the peace of old!

◆ Event Rules ◆
● In Wispae War Saga, Trailblazers will lead Wispae Legions to battle across Graphia Academy. Within the academy, 4 champions hold their ground in different areas, waiting to be challenged.
● After completing each battle, new wispae Legions will be unlocked for use. You can also enhance your Legions in "Battalion Buildup" using Wishpower Crystals. Completing battles will also raise your "Campaign Level."
● Once all battles are complete, Trailblazers can select any acquired Legion to take on mysterious enemies from beyond the sky.

◆ Permanent Rewards ◆
● Complete campaigns to increase your Campaign Level and claim the corresponding Campaign Rewards.
● Campaign Rewards include the chat bubble "Truth Amidst Turmoil."

◆ Limited-Time Rewards ◆
● During the limited-time event, completing specified missions will earn you corresponding rewards.

◆ Event Reminders ◆
● After the Wispae War Saga limited-time event ends, Trailblazers will no longer be able to obtain the limited-time rewards, but they can still visit Fibbs at Graphia Academy to experience the event and obtain permanent rewards.
